name: RSS Feed Keyword Alerts Email Digest Without Duplicates

parameters.content:
### How it works
1. **Check Feeds Every Hour** loads active feeds, keywords and sent-items history from three data tables. An empty or all-inactive feed table stops the run with an error.
2. Each feed is fetched with a timeout and parsed (RSS 2.0, RSS 1.0, Atom). A failing feed (HTTP error, timeout, invalid XML) is skipped and listed in the digest, or, when nothing is new, the run ends with an error.
3. Keywords match case-insensitively as whole words or phrases in title and summary. With include keywords an item needs one; any exclude keyword drops it. No include keywords = all items.
4. Dropped: items already sent, repeated in another feed, or dated older than `retention_days`. Links are compared without http/https, `www.`, #fragment, trailing slash, `utm_*` and click IDs; items without a link by title.
5. One HTML email grouped by feed, then the items are recorded. Nothing new = no email.

### Setup
Tested on n8n 2.48.5.
1. Execute **Run Once to Create Tables** (needs permission to create data tables).
2. Add feeds (`name`, `url`, tick `active`) and keywords (`keyword`, tick `exclude` to block).
3. Attach your SMTP credential to **Send Digest Email**.
4. In **RSS Digest Settings** set `recipient_email`, `from_email` (an address your SMTP account may send from), `retention_days`, `max_items_per_digest`, `feed_timeout_seconds` and the table names.
5. Set the timezone and an Error Workflow in Workflow settings, then activate.

### Customization
Change the schedule; untick `active` to pause a feed.

Limits: a failed email records nothing, so the items come next run. If recording fails after sending, they are sent once more. An undated item still in a feed can come again if the workflow is paused for longer than `retention_days`.

## One-time setup
Creates the feeds, keywords and sent-items tables (skipped if they exist).

## Load tables
Finds the three tables by exact name, deletes history rows not seen for retention_days, then loads active feeds, sent history and keywords. No active feed stops the run with an error. A failed delete is retried on the next run.

## Fetch and parse each feed
One feed per loop pass, with a timeout. A failed fetch or invalid XML becomes an error line, so one broken feed does not stop the others.

## Pick new items
Keyword filter, duplicate check and the HTML digest. History rows of items still in a feed are refreshed before anything can stop the run, so retention keeps them. A failed refresh does not stop the run and is retried next run.

## Send, then record
Items are recorded only after the email was accepted. Nothing new: no email, and failed feeds stop the run with an error for the Error Workflow.

parameters.jsCode:
// History rows to refresh (see Pick New Items).
return $('Pick New Items').first().json.touch.map((t) => ({ json: t }));

// Refresh done (or failed): continue with the one digest item from Pick New Items.
return [$('Pick New Items').first()];

// The email was accepted, so each item in it is recorded now.
return $('Pick New Items').first().json.sent.map((row) => ({ json: row }));
